samples.title: The Keeper of the Old Library
samples.label: English · 3 characters
samples.text:
The monsoon had not stopped for three days when the knock came. Meera was curled beside the lamp with a book she had read four times, and the sound made her sit up so fast that the pages fluttered shut. She held her breath and listened.

"Who knocks at this hour?" Meera whispered.

Her grandfather folded his spectacles and set them on the table. He did not look worried. He rarely did.

"Someone who has walked a long way, child," Baba said. "Let them in before the rain does."

Meera crossed the room and drew back the bolt. A tall man stood on the step, water running from the brim of his hat, a leather satchel pressed against his chest as if it held something alive. His name, she would learn, was Arjun.

"Forgive me," Arjun said. "I'm looking for the keeper of the old library."

"The library burned down twenty years ago," Meera said.

"Not all of it," Arjun said, lifting the satchel a little. "Not the part that matters."

Baba rose slowly from his chair. For a long moment he studied the man's face, and something in his own face changed, as though a door inside him had opened too.

"Arjun," Baba said quietly. "You came back."

"I promised I would," Arjun replied. "I only wish it hadn't taken so long."

"Baba, you know him?" Meera asked, looking from one to the other.

"I taught him to read," Baba said, and laughed, a small surprised sound. "Badly, it seems, if he thinks I am still the keeper."

"Then who is?" Arjun asked.

"Tell him, Meera," Baba said, and his eyes were bright.

She felt the weight of the question settle on her shoulders. Outside, thunder rolled across the hills like something enormous turning over in its sleep.

"I am," Meera said. "And you have found her."

samples.title: बारिश की रात
samples.label: हिन्दी · 3 characters
samples.text:
तीन दिन से बारिश थमी नहीं थी, जब दरवाज़े पर दस्तक हुई। मीरा दीये के पास बैठी एक पुरानी किताब पढ़ रही थी। आवाज़ सुनकर वह चौंक गई।

"इस वक़्त कौन आया होगा?" मीरा ने पूछा।

दादाजी ने चश्मा उतारकर मेज़ पर रख दिया। वे ज़रा भी घबराए हुए नहीं लग रहे थे।

"कोई जो बहुत दूर से चलकर आया है, बेटी," दादाजी ने कहा। "दरवाज़ा खोल दो।"

मीरा ने कुंडी खोली। दरवाज़े पर एक लंबा आदमी खड़ा था। उसकी टोपी से पानी टपक रहा था और उसने सीने से एक थैला चिपका रखा था।

"माफ़ कीजिए," अर्जुन ने कहा। "मुझे पुराने पुस्तकालय के रखवाले की तलाश है।"

"वो पुस्तकालय तो बीस साल पहले जल गया था," मीरा बोली।

"सारा नहीं," अर्जुन ने कहा। "जो सबसे ज़रूरी था, वो बच गया।"

दादाजी धीरे से उठे और देर तक उस आदमी का चेहरा देखते रहे।

"अर्जुन," दादाजी ने कहा। "तुम लौट आए।"

"मैंने वादा किया था," अर्जुन बोला। "बस अफ़सोस है कि इतनी देर लग गई।"

"तो अब रखवाला कौन है?" अर्जुन ने पूछा।

दादाजी मीरा की ओर मुड़े। उनकी आँखों में चमक थी।

"मैं हूँ," मीरा ने कहा। "और आपने मुझे ढूँढ लिया है।"
